attempts.prompt:
CACE Imatges, school-friendly wordless educational narrative. Deliver one wide landscape image. EXACTLY FOUR equal vertical panels in ONE horizontal row from left to right, with pure white margins and three consistent white gutters. Never merge panels, use a second row, crop the first or last panel or insert an inset panel. Clear simplified setting against white with only needed cues. Medium-wide full-action views, eye-level slightly oblique, matching camera position, perspective, dimensions, anatomy, scale, lighting, hair/fur, clothes and object shapes across panels. Repeat the same two characters scene to scene. Favor visual evidence of their actions, visible distinct hands and physical points of contact. No cut-off hands, warped fingers, floating objects, implausible contact, lettering, branding, numbers, panel labels, arrows, speech bubbles, captions or motion graphics. The internal codes A and B are directions only. Preserve every count and all patterns. Stage the action as a natural coherent story.
Exactly two bipedal anthropomorphic animals with consistent functional paws or hands. Flat educational illustration, simple clean color shapes and smooth dark outlines, flat colors only, white-background context.
Use this precise Catalan storyboard. Each numbered prompt is a separate panel. Do not print any text.
L’entrepà i les dues carmanyoles. Actors and fixed identity: A = CANGUR, armilla blau fosc amb un triangle clar al davant, participant que reparteix; B = GOS, samarreta ocre amb dues ratlles blanques al davant, participant que prepara les carmanyoles.
Recurring visual anchors: Dues meitats d’un entrepà amb crosta ondulada i dues carmanyoles amb tapes translúcides de colors diferents.
1. B obre dues carmanyoles sobre la taula mentre A mostra les dues meitats sobre un únic plat.
2. A posa una meitat dins de cada carmanyola. B orienta les frontisses cap a fora.
3. B tanca la primera i A tanca la segona amb les meitats encara visibles a través de la tapa.
4. A i B recullen una carmanyola cadascú i el plat únic queda buit.
attempts.review: Cangur i gos canvien de costat a la tercera vinyeta i tornen a invertir-se a la quarta, sense transició visible. El seguiment de les carmanyoles queda confús.

CACE Imatges, school-friendly wordless educational narrative. Deliver one wide landscape image. EXACTLY FOUR equal vertical panels in ONE horizontal row from left to right, with pure white margins and three consistent white gutters. Never merge panels, use a second row, crop the first or last panel or insert an inset panel. Clear simplified setting against white with only needed cues. Flat two-dimensional cartoon. Exactly two anthropomorphic animal characters.
Cast: A is CANGUR, armilla blau fosc amb un triangle clar al davant; B is GOS, samarreta ocre amb dues ratlles blanques al davant.
Single white plate on left front of a tabletop in all four panels. ONLY this plate. It is NEVER HELD OR LIFTED. At right front are two translucent lunchboxes with attached hinges, blue in front of orange kangaroo, violet in front of brown floppy-eared dog. P1 dog opens both empty boxes while kangaroo indicates the already present plate, which has two halves of a sandwich. P2 kangaroo and dog put a half in each box, single plate now empty, stays exactly fixed. P3 kangaroo closes blue lid and dog closes violet lid. P4 each lifts their own box with a half visible. The one white plate still empty on tabletop, same place.
attempts.review: Un sol plat passa de tenir dues meitats a quedar buit. El gos obre les dues carmanyoles i cadascú hi posa una meitat i s’endú la seva, com a la variant fotogràfica.
